list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation, cross-checked against Exophase via PlanetGTA6, Push Square and PowerPyx. All 55 are offline single-player; there are no online trophies.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the open-world clean-up — and it will unlock on its own. Budget roughly 200 hours for the whole set, as PowerPyx estimates.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and this unlocks automatically; it is the first story trophy and cannot be missed. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so the spoiler toggle in this guide keeps it covered for you. No side work is needed before or after it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. While you are still in Chapter 1, do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in this chapter that may not come back. Everything else in Chapter 1 can be revisited later.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's missions and this unlocks when the chapter ends. Chapter 2 is also when you gain access to both protagonists, which the final meditation needs, so keep playing the story rather than grinding side content early. The name is censored with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full and the trophy unlocks at its close. By now most of Leonida's activities are open, so it is a good moment to start the long grinds — stunts, races and vehicle discovery — between story missions instead of leaving them all for the end. Nothing in this chapter is missable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and this pops when the chapter ends. The story is five chapters long, so after this you are into the final stretch. Keep a manual save before the big late-story missions as a habit — the guides agree there is only one possibly missable trophy in the whole game, but a spare save costs nothing.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, and the 100% completion checklist opens up, so nothing is locked away by finishing the story. This is the last story trophy; everything after it is clean-up.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy unlocks with it. Like all mission trophies it is automatic — just play the mission through to its end. If you ever fail a mission you can retry it from the pause menu, so a failed attempt never costs you the trophy.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and this unlocks automatically. Heist missions tend to be longer than ordinary ones, so set aside an uninterrupted session for it. There is no optional objective to worry about for the trophy — finishing the mission is enough.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops when it ends. Mission trophies are all unmissable because missions can be replayed after a failure, so play it at your own pace. Its name is a spoiler in itself, which is why it is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and this unlocks automatically. The trophy's stylised name matches the mission's own branding in the game. As with every story trophy, simply reaching and finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and this unlocks automatically. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, so expect a mission built around the airport grounds. Like the other mission trophies, finishing the mission is the entire requirement — no side objective is needed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops when it ends. This is the last of the named-mission story trophies, so after it only the chapter and finale trophies remain on the story side. Play it through to the end and move on — nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after you finish the story. PowerPyx and the other guides agree this is the hardest trophy: it folds in the big collectible and activity counts — meditations, stunts, races, vehicles, cards and stranger strands — so treat the checklist itself as your clean-up list. It is a gold trophy and the last big gate before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all feed the stunt counter, and the in-game Progress menu tracks your total. Start early and let the count grow naturally while you drive between missions instead of grinding it in one sitting. PowerPyx lists it among the long grinds, so chip away at it from Chapter 1 onward.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — the game counts distinct kinds of side activity, from races and fishing to the shooting range and arcade games. This is a sampler trophy: spend one session visiting a different activity each time and it pops quickly. If the counter stalls, check the Progress menu to see which activity type you have not tried yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores you on accuracy and speed, so learn one weapon's recoil at a time and replay a challenge until the gold threshold shows. This is widely listed as one of the hardest trophies, so leave it for the clean-up phase when you can focus on it without story pressure.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are time trials through rings, so learn each course's line before pushing for speed — a clean run beats a fast, crashing one. The game tracks which locations you have won at, so work through them one by one and use the map filter to spot the ones left.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so repeat wins on the same course do not count twice. Leonida offers street, off-road and other race types, and each distinct race you win adds one to the total. Spread your wins across the map and check the Progress menu to see how many unique races you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing is a timing activity: watch the line tension, reel in steadily, and do not let the fish snap the line. You can practise the fishing mechanics at any fishing spot first, then take on Cal once you are comfortable with the rhythm.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and play one of its games through to completion. Arcade games are short, so pick whichever cabinet you find first and see it to the end — a high score is not required, just a finished game. This also counts toward trying each activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore and meet people around Leonida, so keep an eye out for new contacts on the map. The strand's missions are unmissable once started, and finishing the last one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger strands that also counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so you are making progress on two trophies at once. Meet Kenton when his strand appears, follow each mission he offers, and finish the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with its final mission. Stranger strands are found by exploring Leonida and answering the contacts who appear on the map, and each strand ends with a finale mission that pops its trophy. Billy's is one of five named stranger finales in this list, all of them hidden trophies.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named finales in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) are five of the eight, so find three more stranger strands by exploring the map and following new contacts. Track your finished strands in the Progress menu and keep exploring any region that still shows an unfamiliar face.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's strand counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it moves both trophies forward. Strands appear as you explore, so if Randy has not shown up yet, keep covering new ground and checking the map.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand with its final mission. Tyrone's finale is the last of the five named stranger finales; once all five are done you still need three more strands for Strangers & Freaks. Keep exploring the state and answering new stranger contacts until the silver pops.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, across 10 locations; meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and progress is tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The final meditation needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Only 15 of 18 are needed for the 100% checklist, but the trophy wants every spot.
trophies.missable_note: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as possibly missable by PowerPyx and GTABase. In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt, and meditate with her. This balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1. It is still UNCONFIRMED whether it is required for this trophy — it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the others — so do it anyway to be safe, and make a manual save first.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the unique animal he wants. Hunting in Leonida means following tracks and signs in the wild areas outside the city, then taking a careful shot — rushing in will spook the animal. This trophy is hidden, so its exact animal is a spoiler; the guide pane keeps it covered until you earn it or turn the spoiler toggle off.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world — so check the map and the Progress menu's collections tab to see which sets are close to complete. Finish any three sets; you do not need every card in the game, just three complete sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the in-game social photo spot check-in: find a marked location, open the WAiNK prompt and snap it. The Progress menu tracks how many locations you have done, so work through the map region by region and let the count grow as you explore.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list, which covers feats across driving, combat, exploration and activities. Challenges tick off passively as you play, so this one mostly takes care of itself during a full playthrough — just check the challenge list now and then. In the clean-up phase, pick the easiest unfinished challenges first to reach 50 quickly.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in a fast car on open roads outside the city, using tunnels and alleys to break line of sight, and keep your partner with you until the wanted stars clear. The trophy pops once the heat is fully gone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and keep the wanted level alive — if it drops to zero the chain breaks. A quick getaway car parked outside each shop helps, and your partner must be with you for all three robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting into a new model for the first time adds it to your discovery count, which the Progress menu tracks. Variety is what counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar you see parked or driving by instead of sticking to one favourite car. Rare and unusual vehicles around the map are worth seeking out once the common ones are done.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a busy fight — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout — and trigger Combat Focus when several enemies are in view, then chain your shots without wasting the slowdown. If you fall short, reload a save and try again in the same spot.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — take a plane and get airborne without following the normal departure routine. This trophy is hidden and its description is deliberately vague, so expect an improvised escape from the airport rather than a booked flight. Try it in free roam when you are not mid-mission.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This trophy involves the Rhino tank — the description is a joke about the heat inside one. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published guides, so the honest advice is: find a Rhino, get inside it, and use it in combat until the trophy pops, and check the community guides linked here for the confirmed method as players pin it down. Do not trust a single unconfirmed claim; the sources below are where the confirmation will appear.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without ever being detected — plan it like a stealth job, not a smash and grab. Case the store first, move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt does not lock the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the biggest heist-style robberies in free roam: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and break away from the police response. Plan a getaway vehicle in advance for each vault, and count your escapes — the fifth successful escape pops this silver trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it and escape with the cash. Armored trucks travel set routes around Leonida, so watch the roads and intercept one, then break away from the police once you have the money. A fast car and a planned escape route make the getaway far easier than improvising under pursuit.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida until the whole map is explored. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state — the coast, the swamps, the small towns and the city districts — and watch the map fill in. The game tracks explored areas in the Progress menu, so use it to find the blank spots you have not reached yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gangs run their own off-the-books operations around the state — find one per gang, hit it and get away. Keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not repeat one, and expect a fight at each operation.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. This is a small world moment rather than a challenge: find a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, sit down with a drink and let the scene play. It is hidden on PlayStation, so the spoiler toggle hides it until earned — fitting for a quiet trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side, in the classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the approach and smash through — the trophy's name is a nod to the series' most famous showroom moment. If the first attempt does not pop it, try a different showroom or a faster car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on a full game there. Bowling is one of the leisure activities in Vice City, so find the alley, pick up a ball and play a frame. This is a quiet world trophy with no combat and no timer, so do it whenever you are passing through the area.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This trophy is about Lucia and Jason as a partnership — its description is deliberately vague and it is hidden until earned, so the exact trigger is a spoiler. The published guides tie it to a partner moment with a crowd watching, so keep playing the story and the duo activities together and it should come naturally. As with the other vague hidden trophies, check the linked guides for a confirmed method if it does not pop on its own.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the story — this trophy tracks decisions you make as Lucia and Jason, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks a count for it, so keep choosing rather than avoiding decision points, and it should unlock as the story's choices accumulate. The exact number of choices needed is not confirmed in the published guides yet, so treat this as one that comes from playing the story rather than grinding.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is UNCONFIRMED in the published guides at the time of writing — its description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has pinned down exactly what. The honest advice: keep playing normally and watch for it, and check the PowerPyx and KeenGamer guides linked here, which are updated as players confirm the trigger. Do not chase rumours that cite no source.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is UNCONFIRMED — its description suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained in Leonida, the kind of odd world event GTA games hide in odd corners. Explore the state's stranger places and keep an eye out for the unusual, and check the linked guides for a confirmed trigger as players report it. This guide will not invent a location for it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl them over. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so the practical tip is: drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and repeat until it registers. Do it away from police so a wanted level does not interrupt the attempt.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts will clean them for a cut — keep feeding bills through until the cumulative total reaches $250,000. This is a long money grind, so it pairs well with the robbery trophies: every vault and truck you rob feeds this total too.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods and anything else with a price tag all count. This comes naturally over a full playthrough, especially once you start buying garage properties and kitting out cars. If you are close at the end, a shopping spree on expensive items closes the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every purchasable garage property — KeenGamer confirms there are 8 of them. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings, and they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot. Save up through the story and buy them as they become affordable; the last one pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles through the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Drive a vehicle you own or have found, open the app and register it — each new registration counts, so use ten different vehicles rather than the same one twice. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is a candidate to register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
